body.name: Whole-set confidence inversion
body.construction: \(\mathcal K_n=\{p\in\mathcal E_e:\lvert p(\omega)-\widehat p(\omega)\rvert\leq r_n\ \forall\omega\in\Omega\},\qquad\mathcal O_n=\{q:\exists p\in\mathcal K_n,\ \exists\{U_h(k)\},\{V_{ha}(k)\}\text{ such that }(q,\{U_h(k)\},\{V_{ha}(k)\})\in\mathcal R(p)\}\)
